xray: ₹{gross} mein se aapke paas ₹{net} bache. Intezaar ka time jodkar asli kamai ₹{hourly} per ghanta hai ({hours} ghante).
flag_unknown: '{label}' naam se ₹{amt} ki anjaani katauti. Support se poora hisab maangein.
flag_total: Kul katauti aapki kamai ka {pct}% hai.
trip: Kiraya ₹{fare}, {km} km. Petrol aur ghisai ke baad lagbhag ₹{net} bachenge (₹{hourly} per ghanta). Salah: {verdict}.
safe: Aaj kharch ki surakshit seema: ₹{limit}. Aaj bacha: ₹{left}. Mahine ke tay kharch: ₹{fixed}. Mahine ki bachat: ₹{sav}.
safe_short: Aapki kamai tay kharchon ke liye kam hai. Kharch ghatayein ya extra kamai dhundhein.
loan: Aapko ₹{recv} milenge aur ₹{total} chukane honge. Asli saalana byaj lagbhag {pct}% hai. Khatra: {risk}. Behtar vikalp: bank, SHG ya PM MUDRA loan.
diary_saved: Mazdoori diary mein likha: ₹{amt} baaki. Tareekh ke saath ye note saboot ban sakta hai.
unsure: Mujhe iska pakka nahi pata aur main andaza nahi lagaunga. Nazdiki CSC par poochhein, e-Shram 14434 par ya kanooni madad ke liye NALSA 15100 par call karein.
sos: SOS: abhi 112 par call karein. Apni live location kisi bharosemand ko bhejein. Emergency 112 | Ambulance 108 | Mahila helpline 181 | Kanooni madad 15100 | Cyber thagi 1930
crisis: Mujhe aapki suraksha ki chinta hai. Abhi kisi insaan se sampark karein. Emergency 112 | Ambulance 108 | Mahila helpline 181 | Kanooni madad 15100 | Cyber thagi 1930. Khatre mein hon to kisi surakshit bheed wali jagah jayein aur live location bharosemand ko bhejein.
secret: Apna OTP, PIN, password ya poora Aadhaar kisi ko na batayein, mujhe bhi nahi. Maine ise aapke message se hata diya hai.
grievance_help: Main vinamra shikayat patra bana sakta hoon. Kram: 1) platform support 2) grievance officer 3) shram vibhag 4) upbhokta forum 5) muft kanooni madad (NALSA 15100). Patra ke liye Help tab kholein.
ask_safe: Apni mahine ki kamai, kiraya, EMI aur bills batayein, main roz ka safe-to-spend number dunga. Money tab kholein.
ask_loan: Loan rashi, mahine ki EMI aur mahine batayein, jaise: loan 10000 emi 1200 for 12 months.
ask_trip: Kiraya aur doori batayein, jaise: trip fare 120 distance 8 km.
knowledge_hdr: Sarkari jaankari (English mein hai - sarkari portal par confirm karein):
shift: Kaam ke sabse acche time: {w1} aur {w2}. Pehle time mein demand sabse zyada hoti hai.
tip_rain: Baarish: shaam ko orders aksar badhte hain. Dheere chalayein aur phone waterproof cover mein rakhein.
tip_heat: Garmi alert: dopahar 12 se 4 baje tak bachein, har ghante paani piyein aur chhaon mein aaram karein.
tip_festival: Tyohar ya event: demand zyada hai. Zyada ghante kaam karein par aaram ka time rakhein.
tip_rest: Har 2 ghante mein 10 minute ka break lein.
incentive: ₹{bonus} ka bonus paane ke liye {rem} trip aur chahiye. Agle {hours} ghante mein lagbhag {per_hr} trip per ghanta karni hongi.
incentive_done: Target poora! Aapko ₹{bonus} ka bonus milega. App mein check karein.
incentive_far: Target mushkil lagta hai ({per_hr} trip per ghanta chahiye). Dekhein ki bonus extra petrol aur time ke layak hai ya nahi.
fatigue_low: Aap theek lag rahe hain. Chhote break lete rahein.
fatigue_med: Aap thak rahe hain. Agli trip se pehle 15 minute aaram karein aur paani piyein.
fatigue_high: Thakan ka khatra zyada hai. Abhi ruk kar aaram karein. Thak kar gaadi chalane se haadse hote hain.
vault_expired: {doc} ko khatam hue {days} din ho gaye. Jurmane se bachne ke liye abhi renew karein.
vault_soon: {doc} {days} din mein khatam hoga. Renewal shuru karein.
risk_interest: Zyada byaj ya charges ka zikr hai. Sign karne se pehle asli saalana dar nikalein.
risk_penalty: Jurmane ki shart hai. Dekhein kitna aur kab lagega.
risk_terminate: Kaam bina notice band ho sakta hai. Notice period aur karan likhit mein maangein.
risk_deduct: Pay se paise kat sakte hain. Sahi rakam aur karan poochhein.
risk_nonrefund: Paisa wapas nahi hoga. Poori shartein padhe bina payment na karein.
risk_advance: Advance ya deposit hai. Receipt aur refund ki shartein likhit mein lein.
risk_none: Koi saaf risky shart nahi mili, phir bhi poora padhein aur kisi bharosemand se poochhein.
petition: Hum {company} ke {n} kaamgaar {city} mein '{issue}' ki samasya bata rahe hain. Shram vibhag aur company se jaanch kar samadhan ki maang hai.
petition_wait: Abhi sirf {n} report hain. Sabki pehchaan gupt rakhne ke liye petition mein kam se kam 3 kaamgaar chahiye.
ui_sub: Paisa, suraksha aur adhikaar mein aapka saathi
ui_disc: Ye kanooni, medical ya financial salah nahi hai. Khatre mein 112 par call karein.
h_trip: Kya ye trip faayde ki hai?
l_doc_text: Notice ya contract ka likha hissa yahan paste karein
letter_note: Ye patra English mein hai taaki aap ise company ko bhej sakein. Bhejne mein kisi bharosemand vyakti ya CSC ki madad lein.
